description:
List the AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt topics of a property. A topic groups prompts on the LLM Tracker page; each item has topic_id and title. Optional includeCompetitors adds competitors (domain, mentioned_pct, cited_pct) aggregated for the topic over the date range. Optional gapOnly keeps topics that have at least one gap prompt (competitor present, tracked brand absent). Date range defaults to last_28_days. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// list prompt topics for the last 28 days
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

competitor_domains.description: Competitor domains to score. When omitted, uses the saved chart selection, else top 5 by share of voice.

gapOnly.description: When true, return only topics with at least one gap prompt in the period.

includeCompetitors.description: When true, each item includes competitors (domain, mentioned_pct, cited_pct) for the period.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; omit range, from and to for last_28_days.

name: list_prompt_topics
title: Prompt topics
